item.title: Kenyan newspapers, October 31: Inside KSh 20b deal that lecturers signed to end strike
item.description: Kenya university lecturers end strike after a KSh20bn deal delivers pay rises, commuter allowance and protections, restoring teaching after weeks of disruption.

item.title: UASU calls off lecturers’ strike after KSh20bn deal, urges students to return to universities
item.description: UASU has called off its four-week lecturers’ strike after signing a KSh20 billion deal with the government, ordering students to return to universities.

item.title: Abel Mutua's Daughter leads Brookhurst students for behind-the-scenes tour of Citizen TV
item.description: Brookhurst International School students, including Abel Mutua’s daughter, Mumbus, toured Citizen TV studios to experience live broadcasting and studio production.

item.title: Lecturers end strike after striking KSh 20b deal with govt
item.description: Kenyan university lecturers will return on November 2 after UASU agreed a KSh 20 billion deal with the government, ending a 26-day strike over pay talks.

item.title: Teacher Cillah reveals amount she gets yearly after invigilating national exams: "Itakuja next year"
item.description: Teacher Cillah revealed her KEPSEA invigilation pay in a viral TikTok, joking that her annual KSh 1,650–1,665 allowance vanished before she could see it again.

item.title: Moi University postpones 49th graduation ceremony amid lecturers’ strike
item.description: Moi University has postponed its 49th graduation set for December 3 as lecturers strike, students face missing marks and local staff grievances remain unresolved.

item.title: Christina Shusho bags honorary doctorate of divinity from US-based theological college
item.description: Tanzanian gospel singer Christina Shusho received an honorary Doctorate of Divinity for her biblical songwriting, Christian ministry and spiritual leadership.
